span.p:
Redis
1 lakh seat map dekh rahe
-> seat map Redis me (~5 sec umar), dekhna wahin se
booking ka faisla sirf main DB ke UPDATE pe
(cache + replica)
Redis me nahi -> replica se banao, Redis me rakho
kisi ne book kiya -> pehle DB, phir Redis se hatao
A1 biki, map me khaali -> chalta, faisla UPDATE ka
